reason: Re-opened packet.js veda 86 --verse 8.48.3 and the pinned revision 202962 (action=raw; API timestamp 2019-05-31). Despite the 15-against-14 verse count, the Sanskrit labelled 3 (apāma somam amṛtā abhūma aganma jyotir avidāma devān) is the app's 8.48.3, so the locator holds. Sāyaṇa glosses abhūma by the optative bhavema and grounds it: yasmāt tvam amṛtaḥ atas tava pānād vayam apy amṛtāḥ syāma, and jyotiḥ as dyotamānaṃ svargam; the sentence ('deathlessness as hoped for from drinking one who is himself deathless, and the light as shining heaven') says exactly that and no more. Wilson's 'may we become immortal; we have attained the light (of heaven)' agrees. verse.js ok (8.48.3 at [667,3]), the key is the verse's first whole sentence. Plain sense faithful to day.js (heart v4, joints v5 and v9). entry-check ok; no tone, school or comparison issue.
